evidence.title: DESIGN.mdのもたらす効能と勘違い｜こぎそ

name: DESIGN.mdのもたらす効能と勘違い
summary: Japanese note article by こぎそ on what DESIGN.md, Google Labs' spec for AI-readable design, does and does not do for coding agents.
description: An essay on DESIGN.md, the open format Google Labs published on GitHub that puts YAML front matter — colour, typography, spacing tokens — in front of a Markdown body to describe a product's visual identity to agents like Claude Code and Cursor. The author explains why the file is often misunderstood as a hard constraint on AI-generated design, what it does and does not deliver, and what is actually needed to control design in practice. Published 2026-09-11 and featured among note's spotlight articles.
